## End-to-End Device Logistics
## Calm, Compliant, On Time.

Since 1999, Amtel has supported carriers, retailers, and enterprise programs across the GCC with
multi-brand electronics. We run a single, standards-led playbook: model-list confirmation,
IMEI/serial validation, HS codes and packing specs, and channel-compliant documentation—so timelines
stay clear and handovers remain predictable.

With operating entities in the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia, we stay close to customers
and standards. We are Apple Authorized in Kuwait and carry strong lines including Samsung, Honor,
Redmi, Tecno, and Sony, plus PlayStation, Nintendo, and Xbox—bringing measured reliability to
launches and replenishment.

[More About Us ][22]
Quick company overview

## Our Operational Highlights
## At A Glance.

Across four GCC entities, Amtel delivers disciplined device logistics with a single operating
standard, verified sourcing, serial/IMEI control, channel-compliant documentation, and measured
handovers. Our governance, tooling, and vendor network enable predictable allocations, fast export
clearance, and zerotolerance quality control, supporting partners from first PO to final store
delivery.

[Our Key Partners →][23]

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

[ Find out more ][64]

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

[ Find out more ][65]

_crawl.linkedin_about: Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to a highly diversified base of business-to-business technology experts. Through Ingram Micro Xvantage™, our AI-powered digital platform, we offer what we believe to be the industry’s first comprehensive business-to-consumer-like experience, integrating hardware and cloud subscriptions, personalized recommendations, instant pricing, order tracking, and billing automation. We also provide a broad range of technology services, including financing, specialized marketing, and lifecycle management, as well as technical pre- and post-sales professional support. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com.

Jomashop is a leading fashion retailer in watches, handbags, sunglasses, jewelry, beauty, fine writing instruments, apparel, shoes and gift items since 1999. Jomashop believes that everyone should be able to wear what they love, and do so with savings in mind. We do this by allowing shoppers to quickly and easily find exactly what they want from over 650 leading international brands and 75,000 unique items. We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver the best prices, most varied selection and finest service for well over 25 years. Our goal has and always will be to earn the trust and satisfaction of our customers. We understand that this means providing the perfect combination of competitive pricing, customer service and a state of the art, New York City based fulfillment center capable of delivering products to every corner of the world.

## About Sharif Group

The Group trades under its legalname "Mohamed Sharif Mohamed & Sons B.S.C.©", a closed Bahraini
shareholding Company registered in the Kingdom of Bahrain with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce
under commercial registration number 598 obtained on 6 February 1974.

[ EXPLORE MORE][14]

## A la Mode

A La Mode, a division of Sharif Group, started in 1995 as a brand trading in fashion accessories,
writing instruments, and leather items, in addition to the well- known watches line which dates back
to 1971.

[SHOP ONLINE][15]

## Sharif Garments Factory

Sharif Garments is the leading supplier of official & civil uniforms in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It
has developed strong and lasting relationships for many years and supplied uniforms for commercial,
industrial, oil, hospitality, educational, military, security establishments

[SHOP ONLINE][16]

## Wool House

Wool House is the brand name for the trading and retailing of textiles arm of the Group. We offer
wide range of most internationally-acclaimed brands of textiles through our outlets in different
shopping malls,

[SHOP ONLINE][17]

## Parfume

The newest addition to the leading retail company Sharif Group, is being introduced as a new concept
in the world of perfumery.

The new division is distinguished in the market due to the gained expertise over the years. As well
as offering a luxurious environment and a customer oriented layout, with fragrances at the
customer’s fingertips, all which suit the sophistication and class of modern perfumery customers.

[SHOP ONLINE][18]

## Let the numbers speak

The Group entry into tailoring business in the 1960's during the development of Bahrain's commercial
and retail industries marked an era of fine tailoring in Bahrain.From its humble beginning, the
enterprise expanded into the trade of watches in 1971

_crawl.linkedin_about: We are RS Group. Making Amazing Happen for a Better World. ONE BRAND. ONE TEAM. ONE CULTURE. We provide the product and service solutions that help our customers design, build, maintain, repair and operate industrial equipment and operations, safely and sustainably. We are the trusted and preferred partners of designers, builders and maintainers of industrial equipment and operations. Since 1937, we have supported generations of engineers with products for all types of applications. Through 86 years we've seen technologies develop and inspirations come to life. Whatever the innovation or industry, RS will continue to support the engineers of tomorrow. With operations in 34 countries, we offer more than 850,000 products to over one million customers, shipping around 60,000 parcels a day. Our products, sourced from 2,500 leading suppliers, include electronic components, electrical, automation and control, and test and measurement equipment, and engineering tools and consumables. DesignSpark connects millions of makers, innovators, students, and design engineers from around the world with a collaborative space and design resources to improve productivity. Our award-winning software, model libraries, tech updates, inspiration and learning help fire up the ordinary and ignite the extraordinary. Our purpose is to educate, influence, promote and enable engineers to design responsibly, for a better world. Our aim is to breed innovation and help every engineer to bring their ideas to life faster. Our DesignSpark community helps do this by connecting over 450,000 registered engineers to like-minded people across the world where they can share projects, ideas and expertise. We are now RS Group plc, formerly Electrocomponents plc, the global distributor for engineers.

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

We deliver software products from concept to deployment and help enhance and scale existing solutions. A strong technology focus and a vibrant local community enable us to attract top talent. We build nearshore development teams from scratch and provide dedicated team extensions for ongoing projects. By working with TechVision, you unlock the full potential of technology for your business. Why clients choose TechVision: • Partnership approach: We treat clients as long-term partners, fostering collaboration and shared ownership of outcomes. • Effective project management: Clear communication, predictable delivery, and regular updates using tools like Jira and Slack. • High-quality deliverables: Reliable, scalable, and well-designed solutions that meet real business needs. • Business mindset and maturity: A strong focus on automating business processes to save time, increase efficiency, and drive measurable impact.

_crawl.linkedin_about: 2Service B.V. is established in 2011 and now manages two webshops for electronic parts. We are one of the largest electronic part distributor for the repair industry. Please, let us introduce you to our webshops: Samsungparts.eu We offer all Samsung parts for TV’s, washing machines, dryers, vacuum cleaners and microwaves via the webshop Samsungparts.eu. Because we are Authorized Samsung Distributor, all parts are 100% original and come directly from the central Samsung warehouse. Each year, we help thousands of consumers to find and deliver the right Samsung part for their white- and brown good appliances . In addition, more than 600 resellers, repair shops and wholesalers make use of our parts service. Experts in the distribution of electronic parts - We serve 10.000+ customers; - We have 500.000+ articles in stock; - We ship 300.000+ parcels a year; - We deliver to 40+ countries worldwide! Mobileparts.shop We proudly serve over 4.000 repair shops in Europe via Mobileparts.shop. We support mobile repair professionals who strive for perfection when it comes to the quality of their repairs and the tools they use to get their repairs done. With our products and services we try to encourage them to further professionalise their shop and to achieve a higher profit margin out of your business. We are more than just a parts distributor. We care about the industry and that is why we offer everything a repair professional needs: the best parts, tools, accessories, devices and services! Request a dealer login to access our webshop, and we’ll help you grow your business. Because Mobile Repair starts at Mobileparts.shop - Preferred supplier of more than 4.000 mobile repair shops in Europe; - We deliver more than 500.000 parts and accessories from stock; - Connected with more than 1.000 Repair professionals through our Facebook groups & blogs; - Rated 4,9 / 5 by customers on Trusted Shops.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Exostretch is a Technology Transfer Start-Up, surrounding a patented thin-film, stretchable battery technology from the University of Houston's Division of Research. Exostretch consists of a management team: Ross Smolen, Akshay Joshi, Dat Vu, and Nathaniel Scott, Public Relations director: Triet Tran, and research team: Dr. Haleh Ardebili Ph.D., Dr. Mejdi Kammoun Ph.D., and Anujan Murugesu. Exostretch is advised by Mary Hakam and Mounir Zok. Mary Hakam is the president of Woodlands Textiles and has created technical textile clothing systems for NASA, WL Gore, and special operations forces. Mary Hakam is also a part of the Advanced Functional Fabrics Of America consortium, establishing standards for smart textiles. Mounir Zok is the director of technology and innovation for the United States Olympic Committee. Exostretch has competed in business plan competitions and has been the recipients of grants including: NASA iTech Program, Caltech FLoW competition, The National Science Foundation's (NSF) In-LA Blitz I-Corps program, Wolff Center for Entrepreneurship's internal competition, Baylor University New Venture competition, NSF Career grant, Texas space grant. Links to press: https://www.egr.uh.edu/news/201810/uh-startup-exostretch-powers-top-ten-finalist-position-battery-future https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sXKu0hwD2ME https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/spacetech/itech/Top_10_iTech_Finalists_Announced https://www.eenewsanalog.com/news/battery-startups-among-nasa-itech-finalists
